name: Found in Translation
source: You missed the bus that morning and decide to just walk to work. On the way, you save two homeless girls from being accosted by a hobo. After deciding to help them get off the street for the night, things don't go to plan.
translation: 那天早上你错过了公共汽车，所以决定步行去上班。在路上，你救了两个被流浪汉搭讪的无家可归的女孩。在决定帮助他们离开街道过夜后，事情并没有按计划进行。
